slides.title: One Task Through the Pods
slides.alt: Deployment diagram with numbered steps 1 to 30. Client, Auctioneer, an EventQueue, a PITAS application with Bidder, pitas-jobs and pitas-scheduler, and pitas-worker-pool, and a Worker. ClientPod, WorkerPod, and an AuctionHousePods group with AuctioneerPod and BidderPod. The Client writes the task input to ClientPod, the Auctioneer creates the auction in AuctioneerPod, the Bidder appends a bid there, and the Worker fetches the task input from ClientPod and appends the result to it.
